name: Cursor CLI
description: Use the local `cursor-agent` binary (Cursor subscription) as an OpenClaw model backend.

providerAuthChoices.choiceHint: Reuse a local `cursor-agent login` on this host (Cursor subscription).

command.description: Path or name of the cursor-agent binary. Must be an absolute path or a simple binary name (default: cursor-agent). Shell metachars are rejected.

mode.description: Execution mode passed to cursor-agent. 'agent' = full agent (default); 'plan' = read-only/planning, no file edits; 'ask' = pure Q&A, read-only.

allowTools.description: If true (default), pass --force --trust so cursor-agent may run its built-in write/shell tools without prompting. Set to false to make tool actions require explicit approval — this disables non-interactive headless runs but is much safer for untrusted workspaces.

sandbox.description: Override cursor-agent's sandbox setting. 'enabled' restricts tool actions to a sandbox; 'disabled' opts out. Leave unset to use cursor-agent's own config default.

extraArgs.description: Extra args appended to every cursor-agent invocation (advanced — most users do not need this).
